subject: planner: support global binding fuzzy matching (#50085)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (planner/bindinfo + session bootstrap test). Global/session binding matching now computes a schema-stripped digest and then disambiguates candidates via per-table schema comparison with support for `*`-schema wildcards, gated by `tidb_opt_enable_fuzzy_binding` for wildcard matches; call sites (planner plan cache + binding lookup) updated accordingly. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, session behavior, or concurrency within the requested scope.
